issue.title: undefined reference with debian11_armv7 on RPi
issue.body:
Back again :)

So the package installed properly but I built an example and finish with undefined reference issue:
```
$ cmake --build build -j4
Scanning dependencies of target takeoff_and_land
[ 50%] Building CXX object CMakeFiles/takeoff_and_land.dir/takeoff_and_land.cpp.o
[100%] Linking CXX executable takeoff_and_land
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/libmavsdk.so.1.0.7: undefined reference to `stat64@GLIBC_2.33'
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/libmavsdk.so.1.0.7: undefined reference to `std::__exception_ptr::exception_ptr::_M_release()@CXXABI_1.3.13'
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/libmavsdk.so.1.0.7: undefined reference to `std::filesystem::__cxx11::path::_List::_Impl_deleter::operator()(std::filesystem::__cxx11::path::_List::_Impl*) const@GLIBCXX_3.4.26'
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/libmavsdk.so.1.0.7: undefined reference to `std::filesystem::status(std::filesystem::__cxx11::path const&, std::error_code&)@GLIBCXX_3.4.26'
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/libmavsdk.so.1.0.7: undefined reference to `pthread_detach@GLIBC_2.34'
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/libmavsdk.so.1.0.7: undefined reference to `std::__exception_ptr::exception_ptr::_M_addref()@CXXABI_1.3.13'
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/libmavsdk.so.1.0.7: undefined reference to `std::filesystem::__cxx11::path::_List::_List()@GLIBCXX_3.4.26'
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/libmavsdk.so.1.0.7: undefined reference to `__libc_single_threaded@GLIBC_2.32'
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/libmavsdk.so.1.0.7: undefined reference to `pthread_join@GLIBC_2.34'
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/libmavsdk.so.1.0.7: undefined reference to `std::filesystem::__cxx11::path::_M_split_cmpts()@GLIBCXX_3.4.26'
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/libmavsdk.so.1.0.7: undefined reference to `std::__atomic_futex_unsigned_base::_M_futex_wait_until_steady(unsigned int*, unsigned int, bool, std::chrono::duration<long long, std::ratio<1ll, 1ll> >, std::chrono::duration<long long, std::ratio<1ll, 1000000000ll> >)@GLIBCXX_3.4.29'
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/libmavsdk.so.1.0.7: undefined reference to `std::__throw_bad_array_new_length()@GLIBCXX_3.4.29'
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/libmavsdk.so.1.0.7: undefined reference to `stat@GLIBC_2.33'
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/libmavsdk.so.1.0.7: undefined reference to `pthread_create@GLIBC_2.34'
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/libmavsdk.so.1.0.7: undefined reference to `pthread_cond_clockwait@GLIBC_2.34'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
make[2]: *** [CMakeFiles/takeoff_and_land.dir/build.make:85: takeoff_and_land] Error 1
make[1]: *** [CMakeFiles/Makefile2:76: CMakeFiles/takeoff_and_land.dir/all] Error 2
make: *** [Makefile:84: all] Error 2
```


To reproduce:
```
wget https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/releases/download/v1.0.7/libmavsdk-dev_1.0.7_debian11_armv7.deb
sudo dpkg -i libmavsdk-dev_1.0.7_debian11_armv7.deb
git clone https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK.git
cd MAVSDK/examples/
cd takeoff_and_land/
cmake -Bbuild -H.
cmake --build build -j4
```

Information regarding my rpi:

```
$ uname -a
Linux 4.19.97-v7+ #1294 SMP Thu Jan 30 13:15:58 GMT 2020 armv7l GNU/Linux
```

comments.body: Which version of glibc do you have on that rpi?

Thank you for the quick answer !

```
$ ldd --version
ldd (Debian GLIBC 2.28-10+rpi1) 2.28
Copyright (C) 2018 Free Software Foundation, Inc.
This is free software; see the source for copying conditions.  There is NO
warranty; not even for MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
Written by Roland McGrath and Ulrich Drepper.
```

By the way, I have the same issue with a docker with Ubuntu18.04/arm/v7
And then I expect you to get `libmavsdk.so.1 not found` which means you have to use armv6 instead of armv7.
It looks like the 32bit images of Raspberry Pi OS are made backwards compatible for RPi 1, so armv6.

Indeed ! 

The version 1.0.8 fixed the build issue of undefined reference, but with `libmavsdk.so.1` not found as you said:
```
$ ./takeoff_and_land 
./takeoff_and_land: error while loading shared libraries: libmavsdk.so.1: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
```

but using the armv6 I can run the example. 

Thank you for the great support !!!
Thanks for following up, and glad it's now working!

issue.title: libmavsdk.so.1: cannot open shared object file for armv7

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
I need to build locally .deb package for armv7 as the v1.4.3 does not include some fix

When I build my code in a docker using the online debian package from release v1.3.1 everything works fine. But  when I generate locally the deb package of v1.3.1 or v1.4.3 if fails with error:
```
error while loading shared libraries: libmavsdk.so.1: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
```

What need to be changed in my commands to make it works as if I was downloading the deb package ?
```
./dockcross-linux-armv7-custom /bin/bash -c "cmake $superbuild $cmake_prefix_path -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=build/linux-armv7/install -DBUILD_MAVSDK_SERVER=OFF -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON -DWERROR=OFF -DMAVLINK_HEADERS=mavlink-headers/include -Bbuild/linux-armv7 -H."
./dockcross-linux-armv7-custom cmake --build build/linux-armv7 -j8 --target install
./dockcross-linux-armv7-custom tools/create_packages.sh ./build/linux-armv7/install . armv7 libmavsdk-dev
```

Thank you for your help !
